allow: PowerShell($target = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.agents\\skills"; $link = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\skills"; if \(Test-Path $link\) { Write-Host "ALREADY_EXISTS: $link" } else { try { New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path $link -Target $target -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Host "OK: created symlink"; Get-Item $link | Select-Object Name, LinkType, Target | Format-List } catch { Write-Host "FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($target = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.agents\\skills"; $link = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\skills"; if \(Test-Path $link\) { Write-Host "ALREADY_EXISTS: $link" } else { cmd /c mklink /J "$link" "$target" 2>&1; if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\) { Write-Host "---"; Get-Item $link | Select-Object Name, LinkType, Target | Format-List; Write-Host "Files visible through link:"; \(Get-ChildItem $link | Measure-Object\).Count } else { Write-Host "FAILED with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" } })
